title: About the site
subtitle: A quick guide to every screen: what it's for, where everything is and what to look for when you get stuck.
zoom: Open the screenshot at full size

start.title: Where to start
start.subtitle: Four steps and the site builds teams with what you own.

steps.1: Tap the pencil icon at the top and type your in-game name.
steps.2: In My roster, mark the agents and uniforms you own and equip their CTPs.
steps.3: In Alliance Battle, open today and check the Meta. Tap Build my team to build yours.
steps.4: After playing, log your points in Scores and follow your progress.

items.saved: Everything you mark (roster, teams, CTPs, name and scores) is saved on the device and in your account: sign in on another device and it's all there.
items.sync: If you're asked which version to keep, this device and your account differ. Pick the one with your latest changes.
items.help: Every screen has a help button (?) in the corner with a summary of what to do there.
items.password: Forgot your password or have no access? Talk to an alliance administrator: only they create accounts and change passwords.
items.error: Seeing an error? Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, tell an administrator.

header.title: Top bar
header.intro: It's on every screen. Use it to switch screens and adjust the site to your liking.

markers.1: Menu (phone): opens the site's screens plus language, text size and theme.
markers.2: Site screens (PC): Alliance Battle, My roster, Rotations, Statistics and Scores.
markers.3: Support: the Pix key to help whoever maintains the site.
markers.5: Text size: make it bigger if it's hard to read.
markers.7: Your in-game name: shown on the images you export.
markers.8: My account: this guide, Administration (admins only) and Sign out.

tips.1: On the phone, language, text size and theme are inside the menu (☰).
tips.2: Lost? Tap Alliance Battle: it always opens on today.
tips.3: To come back to this guide, open My account and tap About the site.

cycle.title: Alliance Battle: the cycle
cycle.intro: The home screen. It shows the 28 days of the cycle with BAX and BAL side by side; on BAI days, only BAI happens.

markers.1: The 28 days of the cycle: tap a day to jump to it. Today is lit and BAI days are red.
markers.2: Today: back to the current battle day from anywhere on the page.
markers.3: Weeks: show only one week (S1 to S4) or all of them.
markers.4: Export: download the cycle table (full, Meta only or only your teams) to share with the group.
markers.5: Clear teams: deletes the teams you built (all or one mode). Roster and CTPs stay.
markers.6: Help: what the colors, the green check and the CTP icon on portraits mean.

tips.1: The battle day turns at 12:00 and weekly points reset at 22:00 on reset day (Brasília time).
tips.2: Faded portrait = you don't own the agent yet. Mark it in My roster.
tips.3: Blue frame is a hero, red is a villain.

day.title: The day: Meta and my team
day.intro: Each day has BAX and BAL, with the restriction, the Meta team, the alternatives and the team you built.

markers.1: You are here: the current battle day and how long until it turns.
markers.2: Season effect: stun the boss with this effect on every day of the mode.
markers.3: Day restriction: who can fight (e.g. villains only, female only). With several, all apply together.
markers.4: Meta: the team recommended by Sword Brasil, with each agent's uniform and CTP.
markers.5: Alternative: another good option if you're missing someone from the Meta.
markers.6: My team: the team you built for the day.
markers.7: Build or edit my team: opens the team builder (next section).

tips.1: The leader with See rotation is the Damage Dealer: tap it to see how to use their skills.
tips.2: Green check on the name = you own the agent. Without it (and with a faded portrait), mark the agent in My roster.
tips.3: Missing the whole Meta? Use the Alternative or Apply suggestion in the builder.

team.title: Build my team
team.intro: Pick the day's three agents (leader and two supports), plus each one's CTP and Striker. Only agents that meet the restriction show up.

markers.1: Pick from every character: build without filling your roster (the restriction still applies).
markers.2: Copy Meta or Copy Alternative: copies the recommended team at once.
markers.3: Apply suggestion: the best possible team with what you own.
markers.4: Change agent: pick another agent for this position.
markers.5: CTP 1 and CTP 2: which of the character's two CTPs to use on this day.
markers.7: Tags: green = same as Meta, amber = different, red = you don't own the agent or the uniform.
markers.8: CTPs: drag a CTP onto an agent, or tap the CTP and then the agent.
markers.9: Suggestion for your roster: the team Apply suggestion will use.

tips.1: Everything red? You haven't marked your roster yet. Mark it in My roster or turn on Pick from every character.
tips.2: Days without restrictions can share a team: the site offers to copy it to the other free days.
tips.3: Everything saves on its own. Just close the window.

roster.title: My roster
roster.intro: Mark the agents and uniforms you own and each one's CTPs. That's what builds your teams and the suggestions.

markers.2: Filters by gender, side, species and attack type (on the phone, under the Filters button).
markers.4: Uniform: tap to mark or unmark. Owning one uniform already counts the agent as yours.
markers.5: Mark all of the agent's uniforms at once (or Unmark).
markers.6: The character's CTP 1 and CTP 2: they apply on every day. CTP 2 is optional, to alternate by day.
markers.7: Equip CTPs: drag a CTP onto the character (on PC it sits next to the list).

tips.1: Can't find an agent? Clear the search and the filters.
tips.2: Mark your roster once: the rest of the site uses it from then on.

rotations.title: Rotations
rotations.intro: The skill order of each Meta Damage Dealer, by uniform, with an explanation and a video when available.

markers.1: All characters: back to the list of who has rotations.
markers.2: The character and which uniform the rotation is for.
markers.3: The rotation: skills in order, left to right, with the description below.
markers.4: How to read the notation: what c, dc, qc, the parentheses and symbols mean.

tips.1: Numbers are the skills in the order of the game screen. 6 is the Ultimate, Awakened or Tier-4.
tips.2: You can also get here from the See rotation button on each day's leader.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.intro: Who shows up the most in the cycle's teams (good investments) and the CTPs you equipped.

markers.1: Metas: counts the teams recommended by Sword Brasil.
markers.2: My teams: counts the teams you built.
markers.3: Mode: all, BAX only, BAL only or BAI only.
markers.7: My equipped CTPs, by type and quality.

tips.1: Not sure who to invest in? Check the top of Metas: they show up most often in the cycle.
tips.2: CTP chart empty? Equip CTPs in My roster.

scores.title: Scores
scores.intro: Log your points for each mode and see whether you improved against the same day last month. Only you see your scores.

markers.1: Summary: today, the week, the season and your best day.
markers.2: Choose the day to log (it opens on today).
markers.3: Points for each mode: saved when you leave the field. Deleting the number removes it.
markers.4: The team you built for that day, to remember who you played with.
markers.5: Help: how the reset, normal BA and comparisons work.

tips.1: On reset day (Thursday) log twice: before and after 22:00.
tips.2: No need to log normal BA: it's added to the total on its own.
tips.3: Green went up, red went down, always against the same day and week last month.

admin.title: Administration
admin.intro: Admins only. Everything members see lives here: restrictions, Meta teams, catalog, rotations and accounts.

markers.1: Tabs: Overview, Days, Metas, Catalog, Rotations, CTPs, BAI, Users and Settings.
markers.2: Days: each BAX and BAL day's restriction.
markers.3: Metas: each day's Meta and Alternative teams, free BAL and BAI.
markers.4: Users: create accounts, change role and password and delete who left the alliance.

tips.1: Everything you publish shows up for members right away, with date and author.
tips.2: Account marked Duplicate: the person has two accounts. Delete the unused one.
